title.justification: The title 'Discrete Key-Value Bottleneck' is clearly stated in the document, and it appears consistently as a focal point of discussion in the introduction and throughout the text.

extractions.description: This paper proposes a novel model architecture aimed at addressing the challenges faced by deep neural networks when dealing with non-stationary training data streams, such as in continual learning. The model introduces a discrete bottleneck containing pairs of key-value codes, which is designed to minimize catastrophic forgetting by enabling localized and context-dependent updates. The paper presents theoretical and empirical analyses demonstrating the model's effectiveness in enhancing generalization under distribution shifts, particularly in class-incremental learning scenarios.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central focus of the paper is on developing a machine learning model architecture to improve continual learning under distribution shifts. While these technological improvements can indirectly contribute to various fields, such as sustainability, the paper does not explicitly frame the work within the context of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In the present work, we propose a model architecture to address this issue, building upon a discrete bottleneck containing pairs of separate and learnable key-value codes.
